description: This file defines the 'GatewayInboundConnection' class which manages inbound network connections to a gateway in the Orleans distributed application framework. It handles message receipt, routing, overload detection, and connection lifecycle management within the Orleans runtime.

classes.name: GatewayInboundConnection
classes.description: A sealed class managing an inbound Gateway connection in Orleans, handling message processing, routing, overload detection, and connection lifecycle.

methods.name: RecordMessageReceive
methods.description: Records the reception of a message, including instrumentation and metrics collection.

methods.name: RecordMessageSend
methods.description: Records a message being sent, updating relevant instrumentation counters.

methods.name: OnReceivedMessage
methods.description: Main logic to process incoming messages: handles dropped, overload, reroute, or direct send scenarios.

methods.name: RunInternal
methods.description: Executes the connection setup, including handshake via connection preamble, lifecycle management, and validation.

methods.name: PrepareMessageForSend
methods.description: Prepares messages before sending, e.g., filling in sender address, and handles expired messages.

methods.name: FailMessage
methods.description: Handles message failure cases by logging and sending rejection if request, or dropping the message.

methods.name: RetryMessage
methods.description: Retries a message if it has remaining retries, or fails it if retry limit exceeded.
